[Bosque Deriel, Hermit's Shacks] (230008)Here on the route between the sacred sites of the Observatory and the Faery Ring is a semi-circular clearing.  At its center stands a hut made of lashed branches, roofed with broad leaves.  A certain sect of Elven clerics, who are renowned for their devotion to contemplation, are wont to retire into the solitudes of the woods and groves hereabouts.  They are not, however, renowned for their hospitality.Also here: Monster Brenna, Soul Annihilator Corwin and Delphine.Obvious paths: north, south.

Brenna narrows his eyes, focused within his fury.
Delphine glances up at the sky.
After a few moments she lowers her gaze.
You scan the skies for a few moments.
The blue moon Xibar has waned to a narrow crescent of light.
It is fairly close and is shining brightly.
You see nothing else of note.
